consequences: Profile fields are set by people only and rarely race. A comment at updateProfile says why there is no check.
context: Every record write bumps the writing actor's version in issueStamp (services/context.ts). An expected version taken from a profile view would be stale almost every time, so the edit would fail.
decision: updateProfile writes without an expected version; the last write wins for display name, initials and colour.
title: updateProfile keeps no version check (review 9.4)
